verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at developers.openai.com, describing itself as a documentation hub for the OpenAI API, and the speech-to-text guide is served as a markdown (.md) page, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs that include the hosted transcription API. The pack does not show that the llms.txt indexes the speech-to-text or Whisper pages, and the open-source openai/whisper repo has no llms.txt of its own, only a raw README.md. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt explicitly links the speech-to-text/Whisper docs, an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs for the open-source Whisper project, a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Complete documentation hub for OpenAI API
